title: Renting an Apartment
subtitle: Touring a place and discussing the lease — for English learners

sentences.en: Thanks for showing me the apartment today. It looks really nice.
sentences.target: Thanks for showing me the apartment today. It looks really nice.

sentences.en: I'm glad you like it. The previous tenant lived here for five years.
sentences.target: I'm glad you like it. The previous tenant lived here for five years.

sentences.en: Could you tell me how much the monthly rent is, including utilities?
sentences.target: Could you tell me how much the monthly rent is, including utilities?

sentences.en: Rent is twelve hundred dollars, and water is included. You pay your own electricity and internet.
sentences.target: Rent is twelve hundred dollars, and water is included. You pay your own electricity and internet.

sentences.en: Is the security deposit one month or two months of rent?
sentences.target: Is the security deposit one month or two months of rent?

sentences.en: It's one month, returned within thirty days after you move out.
sentences.target: It's one month, returned within thirty days after you move out.

sentences.en: Are pets allowed? I have a small, well-behaved cat.
sentences.target: Are pets allowed? I have a small, well-behaved cat.

sentences.en: Yes, cats are fine — there is a small one-time pet fee of two hundred dollars.
sentences.target: Yes, cats are fine — there is a small one-time pet fee of two hundred dollars.

sentences.en: How long is the lease, and can I renew it after the first year?
sentences.target: How long is the lease, and can I renew it after the first year?

sentences.en: It's a standard twelve-month lease, and renewal is usually available if your payments are on time.
sentences.target: It's a standard twelve-month lease, and renewal is usually available if your payments are on time.

sentences.en: Perfect. I'd like to apply. What documents do you need from me?
sentences.target: Perfect. I'd like to apply. What documents do you need from me?
